visualCharacteristics: No accordion variant exists. Full-width rounded bordered rows with a circular chevron button. | Bold "Please note:" paragraph, then H3 "Fund specific risks" and 6 full-width rounded bordered accordion rows with a circular chevron button on the right; panels hold a bulleted risk list and a closing paragraph.

contentPattern.description: Accordion with 6 fund items (UK Dynamic Equity, UK Income, UK Multi Cap Income, UK Mid Cap, UK Growth, UK Smaller Companies), each panel a risk list plus a note

cells: Content: bulleted risk list with bold risk names, then "For a more detailed explanation of risk factors..." paragraph

usage.description: Expandable list of full-width rounded bordered rows with a circular chevron toggle (native details element). One row per item: title (plain text) | rich-text panel (lists, paragraphs).

reuseGuidance: Use for fund-specific risk lists, FAQs and other collapsible detail.
